y9-11g-q13.question: Triangle \(ABC\) has vertices \(A(2, 1)\), \(B(5, 5)\) and \(C(9, 2)\). By calculating gradients, show that \(\Delta ABC\) is right-angled.
y9-11g-q13.hint: Compute the gradients of the three sides. Look for two sides whose gradients multiply to give \(-1\).
y9-11g-q13.answer:
Proof: Gradient m_AB = 4/3, m_BC = -3/4.
Since m_AB * m_BC = -1, AB is perpendicular to BC, so angle B is 90 degrees.
